Clinical Profile & Practice Standards

About Charak Health Solutions

Specialized Non-Surgical Ayurvedic Pain Management & Joint Preservation

Charak Health Solutions is a specialized Ayurvedic medical clinic located in Thane West, Maharashtra. Founded and led by Dr. Surabhi Sunil Vaidya, the clinic is dedicated to helping patients manage chronic knee and spinal conditions through authentic classical Ayurveda, Marma therapy, and customized Panchakarma procedures before surgical options are considered.

Our Clinical Philosophy

We believe in honest, diagnostic-first medicine. Our objective is to identify the root cause of musculoskeletal pain, relieve stiffness, support functional mobility, and explore conservative Ayurvedic care options tailored to each patient's individual stage of degeneration.

With over 15 years of dedicated clinical practice, Dr. Surabhi Vaidya has evaluated thousands of chronic joint and spine cases, focusing on:

  • Knee Osteoarthritis (Sandhivata): Managing joint stiffness, pain during walking and stairs, and reduced joint space.
  • Sciatica & Lumbar Disc Conditions (Gridhrasi): Relieving sciatic nerve compression, lower back spasms, and radiating pain.
  • Cervical Spondylosis (Manyastambha): Alleviating neck stiffness, arm radiating discomfort, and upper back tightness.
  • General Age-Related Mobility Restrictions: Supporting joint ease and independent daily mobility.

Our 4-Pillar Ayurvedic Care Method

Rather than masking symptoms temporarily, our clinic utilizes classical Ayurvedic protocols designed to support natural tissue health:

  • 1. Snehana (Medicated Oil Application): Warm herbal oil applications cooked with classical herbs to nourish dry joint capsules and reduce mechanical friction.
  • 2. Swedana (Herbal Fomentation): Medicinal thermal steam fomentation to open micro-circulatory channels and ease deep muscular stiffness.
  • 3. Janu Basti & Kati Basti (Bio-Reservoirs): Specialized herbal dough reservoirs retaining warm medicated oil directly over the knee or lumbar spine to ease localized tension and nourish tissues.
  • 4. Shaman Aushadhi (Classical Internal Formulations): Standardized classical Ayurvedic formulations tailored to individual constitution (Prakriti) to support bone, joint, and nerve health.

Realistic Expectations & Objective Care

We do not make blanket guarantees or fixed percentage outcome promises. Every patient's response to Ayurvedic therapy depends on their age, clinical stage of wear, general health, and lifestyle adherence. For early to moderate stages of joint wear (Stages 1 to 3), conservative non-surgical therapy can significantly enhance quality of life and comfort. For advanced Stage 4 cases with complete loss of joint space or severe neurological deficit, Dr. Surabhi provides clear, objective advice, including appropriate surgical referrals.
